blocks.content: NITI Aayog serves as the premier policy Think Tank of the Government of India, providing directional and policy inputs.

rows: Allocated central funds to states and ministries
Advisory role only; no fund allocation powers
Passive participation via National Development Council
Active participation as direct members of Governing Council

items: NITI Aayog is a non-constitutional and non-statutory body established via an executive Cabinet Resolution.
Unlike the Planning Commission, NITI Aayog has no power to allocate financial funds to state governments or central ministries.
The Governing Council includes Chief Ministers of all states and Lt. Governors of Union Territories.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NITI Aayog acts as the premier policy Think Tank of the Government of India, providing both directional and policy inputs.
It fosters cooperative federalism by ensuring continuous and structured support mechanisms for state governments.
It operates through two major hubs: the Team India Hub and the Knowledge and Innovation Hub.
Replaced the 65-year-old Planning Commission to transition from a command-economy approach to a modern development framework.
